instr: New device: learn what six unfamiliar buttons do, then use them to set some lamps without help.
clue: This device has three lamps and six unfamiliar buttons. First goal: a key under the buttons explains them, so learn what each one does. For the next two goals the key is hidden: reach each goal from memory. A dashed frame around the lamps means edit mode is on; the small mark shows the selected lamp. You can also press 1–6 for the buttons. Press Start when ready.
goal: Make the lamps: left {l}, middle {m}, right {r}. Then confirm.
funcs: Move the selection one lamp to the left (only outside edit mode)
Move the selection one lamp to the right (only outside edit mode)
Turn edit mode on or off
Give the selected lamp its next colour: off, red, yellow, blue, off… (only in edit mode)
Confirm and finish the goal (only outside edit mode)
